verdict.rationale: Supabase does offer Edge Functions (supabase-docs-8) and real-time Postgres Changes streaming (supabase-docs-5/22/23), which are the building blocks for event-driven execution, but the evidence pack never documents the actual Database Webhooks / Auth Hooks mechanism that automatically invokes a function on insert/update/delete or auth events. Missing for 10: explicit docs or hands-on proof of Database Webhooks/Auth Hooks wiring DB/auth events directly to function invocation, and any developer confirmation that this works reliably in practice.
